title: Explore the solar system from the landing page
description: This verifies that a visitor can use scrolling and body interactions on the home experience to discover celestial details and continue exploring through the solar system.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to move through the solar system experience
Verify an informational panel is displayed
Hover over a celestial body
Verify contextual details are displayed for the hovered body
Click the mini-map to jump to another section
Verify a different celestial body is now in focus

title: Open a body detail from the home experience
description: This verifies that a visitor can move from the interactive solar system into a deeper celestial body view and see the detailed context update.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll through the solar system experience
Hover over a celestial body
Click the interactive body to open its detailed context
Verify the body detail view is displayed
Verify detailed information about the selected celestial body is displayed

title: Use the mini-map to reach another part of the solar system
description: This verifies that a visitor can jump within the home experience using the mini-map and continue browsing a different section.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to enter the solar system experience
Click the mini-map to jump to a different section
Verify the scene has moved to a different celestial body
Verify the corresponding informational panel is updated

title: View contextual details by hovering a planet
description: This verifies that hovering a celestial body on the landing page reveals contextual information for discovery without leaving the experience.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Scroll to a celestial body that can be inspected
Hover over the celestial body
Verify contextual details for the hovered body are displayed

title: View a celestial body detail page
description: This test verifies that a visitor can open a celestial body detail page and see the detailed information for that object.

steps.description: Navigate to /body/[id]
Verify detailed celestial body information is displayed
Verify contextual information about the body is visible

title: Browse space categories on the explore page
description: This verifies that a visitor can open the explore page, review available categories, and see category-focused content after selecting one.

steps.description: Navigate to /explore
Verify space categories are displayed
Select a category of interest
Verify category-focused content is displayed

title: Review the galaxies overview content
description: This test verifies that a visitor can open the galaxies page and view the main overview content for galaxy exploration.

steps.description: Navigate to /galaxies
Verify galaxies overview content is displayed
Verify related galaxy information is visible

title: Browse and read a space event story
description: This verifies that a visitor can open the events page, read a story from the list, and view its detailed content.

steps.description: Navigate to /events
Verify a list of space events and news items is displayed
Open an event item
Verify the selected story details are displayed

title: Switch between categories on the explore page
description: This verifies that a visitor can change the selected category on the explore page and update the displayed content accordingly.

steps.description: Navigate to /explore
Select one category
Verify category-focused content is displayed
Select a different category
Verify the displayed content changes to the newly selected category

title: Understand a celestial body in context from a detail page
description: This test verifies that a visitor can review a body detail page and use the displayed content to understand the body's characteristics and context.

steps.description: Navigate to /body/[id]
Scroll to the detailed information section
Verify the body description content is displayed
Verify supporting characteristics or context content is visible

title: Continue from one event story to another
description: This verifies that a visitor can move from one event story to another while staying in the events area.

steps.description: Navigate to /events
Open an event item
Verify the selected story details are displayed
Continue to another event or news story
Verify a different story is displayed

title: Use galaxies content to continue exploring related information
description: This test verifies that a visitor can move from the galaxies overview into another related section and keep browsing cosmic structure content.

steps.description: Navigate to /galaxies
Click a related section link on the galaxies page
Verify a related astronomy content section is displayed

title: Handle invalid body detail routes gracefully
description: This verifies that an invalid celestial body route shows an appropriate not-found or empty state instead of a broken detail view.

steps.description: Navigate to /body/[id]
Verify an invalid-body empty or not-found state is displayed

title: Handle an invalid celestial body route
description: This test verifies that visiting an invalid celestial body route shows a graceful not-found or empty-state experience instead of a broken page.

steps.description: Navigate to /body/[id]
Verify a not-found or empty-state message is displayed
Verify celestial body detail content is not displayed

title: Show a usable empty state on the galaxies page
description: This verifies that the galaxies page presents a clear empty or missing-content state when overview content is unavailable.

steps.description: Navigate to /galaxies
Verify a galaxies overview or empty state is displayed

title: Show a usable empty state when no event content is available
description: This verifies that the events page presents a clear empty state when there are no items to browse instead of a blank screen.

steps.description: Navigate to /events
Verify an empty state message is displayed
